dedupe_keys.name: conditional neural network wind pressure statistical estimation on building structures

description: Conditional Neural Network Wind Pressure Statistical Estimation on Building Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Haifeng Wang, Washington State University (wsu.edu). This publication provides a set of neural network models for the estimation of wind pressure distribution over building surfaces. The models have two inputs, i.e., the wind condition vector and the coordinates vector. The wind condition vector has 6 elements [width, depth, height, roof slope, incidence wind angle, side number]. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-nqte-rg86. Keywords: Deep learning, conditional neural network, hypernetwork, wind engineering, wind tunnel, wind pressure. Published 2023-07-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
